about: Bundles (plans/22-bundles.md, D-39): sets of questions chosen before a session. `languages`: the locales a bundle is offered in; the game offers only its language's bundles (D-85). `kind: base`: a base bundle, exactly one per session; players switch the other bundles on or off. Every question is in exactly one bundle (`bundle`, default base). Bundles add questions and don't own a topic. `rule` (English) is how the pipeline decides membership, `voice` (English) its Spanish usage in prompts (D-78); `name` and `description` are for the game.

bundles.name: Básico
bundles.description: Preguntas de todo un poco, para jugar en cualquier parte.
bundles.rule: Everything that isn't in another bundle: answerable by families anywhere in the world, whatever their language; well-known facts about any country belong here (Colombia's capital, Japan's flag, Italian pasta, García Márquez), knowledge only one country's or one language's players have doesn't.
bundles.voice: idiomatic Latin American Spanish (es-419): words a family anywhere in Latin America uses; Spain has its own es-ES text

bundles.name: Regional: Colombia
bundles.description: Para quien tiene relación con Colombia: lugares, comida, costumbres, gente, música y palabras de allá.
bundles.rule: Answering needs a connection to Colombia: Colombian places, food, customs, festivals, people, music, sport, words, sayings or history that the players outside Colombia mostly wouldn't know.
bundles.voice: Spanish with Colombian usage: "bombillo", "carro", "celular", "gripa", "crispetas", "arquero", "tinto" (black coffee), "parcero" only in jokes
